_comment: Declared connector definitions and connection records (OG-CONN-002, OG-CONN-003). Nothing here authorizes anything: every connection is level 0 (Registered), holds no credential and has never synced. maxLevel is the ceiling the owner set in docs/04 section 5; a connection may never exceed it. Scope lists are the MINIMUM a level would need, recorded before any authorization so the owner can read them first.

scopes.why: Read allowlisted repository metadata and check conclusions. No contents, no workflows, no writes.

connectors.docs: GitHub REST API reference, to be read and pinned at the start of v0.3 (OD-07).
connectors.notes: Level 1 is the ceiling: OctopusG never writes to a repository through a connector.

scopes.why: List projects, deployments and domains to compare declared with served state. Environment variable values are never read.

connectors.docs: Vercel REST API reference, to be read and pinned at the start of v0.3.
connectors.notes: Promotion and rollback are v0.10 execution work and are not actions of this connector.

scopes.why: Owner-reviewed schema and migration inventory only. No rows, no function bodies, no queries, no credentials.

connectors.docs: Supabase management API reference, to be read and pinned at the start of v0.9.
connectors.notes: Migrations are tier Production in docs/06 and are never reachable from this connector.

scopes.why: Issue a bounded GET to an explicitly approved HTTPS route. No arbitrary URL input and no response body is stored.

connectors.docs: docs/CONNECTOR_PLAN_v0.2.md, section on approved HTTP route probes.
connectors.notes: Authentication is none because the probe is anonymous; that does not make it enabled.

scopes.why: Read-only Git status for the paths in config/observe.allowlist.json on an enrolled, personally owned device.

connectors.notes: The owner-run observer (npm run observe, WP-03) is the implementation of these observations. It is started by the owner from the command line and is not driven by the Connection Center; this definition records its contract, ceiling and scope.

connections.note: Registered only. Authorizing GitHub is an owner action scheduled for v0.3 under OD-07.
Registered only. The deployment drift view compares recorded evidence, never live Vercel state.
Registered only. OD-03 (containment of known plaintext secrets) blocks connector authorization until it is resolved.
Registered only. No route has been approved, so there is nothing this connector could probe even if it were enabled.

connections.dataFreshness: see Deployment drift for observation freshness
connections.note: Registered only in the Connection Center. Observations come from the owner-run npm run observe, not from this record.
